findings.reason: an implementer following the Deliverable literally must either edit reckon/crew/obligations.py (outside the declared write paths, a scope blocker) or invent an ambiguous record lookup the plan never settles, so the plan is wrong about where the fix lands and what it must change.
findings.text: the Deliverable names `_finding_dispose_commands` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2458-2471) as the place the rubric is known because the record is held there, but at those lines the function signature is `(project, run_id, index)`, so it holds neither the record nor the rubric; the record is held one frame up, in `_review_dispatch_refusal` (reckon/crew/obligations.py:653, record at :700-708 and :715) and `_open_review_refusal` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2474+), and the duty rows that print the command are produced at reckon/crew/obligations.py:706 and :809, both outside the section's declared write paths. Worse, a re-read inside `_finding_dispose_commands` cannot disambiguate: `_undisposed_blocking_findings` is applied per stored record, so a text record and a figure record that each carry a blocking finding at index 0 call the composer with identical `(project, run_id, 0)` arguments and nothing names which rubric applies.
